trades.thesis: Post-earnings gap of about +25% to a new high (227 vs prior 192 range top) on heavy volume. Post-earnings drift tends to continue after big upside surprises. The July gap held and drifted higher for weeks. Price/volume only, no news access.

extensions.thesis: Post-earnings gap (+25% on 5M shares) holding for 2.5 weeks; 245 vs 255 peak, and it fell only 0.3% on a -1.9% SPY day. Drift thesis intact but volume is fading, so stop is trailed to just above the 11/5 reversal low. Price/volume only.
